description: Assign remediation tiers using latest or dated EPSS and caller-supplied CVSS base severity. Defaults are severity >= 7 and EPSS probability >= 0.10; select percentile explicitly for population rank. Missing severity stays in epssOnly and missing EPSS stays unscored. Thresholds are policy conventions, not FIRST guidance. Process up to 500 unique entries from batchOffset, returning whole entries within the byte budget. Resume using nextBatchOffset as batchOffset, the original cves with original cvssBaseScore values, returned score date as date, and the same severityThreshold and likelihood. Deferred lists may be declared previews; withheldCves were already processed.
